slides.heading: Counting Patterns
slides.body: Counting Patterns is part of Definite Iteration. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Counting Patterns
slides.body: Counting patterns use loops to produce predictable number sequences. They help learners connect repetition with output structure.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A counting pattern is like clapping to a rhythm: the same rule repeats until the pattern is complete.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Use for loops when you want to repeat through a known range or sequence.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Use a for loop to count from 5 to 1.
